_instructions: All records are cross-surface. No journey or slice may be assessed, changed, or closed independently from its required readers, writers, and downstream effects.

multiSurfaceScope.sliceContract: all 24 journey slices are integrated in every stage

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines platform model and domain truth ownership
evidenceIndex.result: DSH is operational truth, WLT is sole financial truth, surfaces compose only
evidenceIndex.limitations: Normative repository instruction; implementation still requires code proof

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines ordered journey ranges and closure rules
evidenceIndex.result: 107 journeys, 24 slices, zero unmapped controls, zero parallel truths, same-SHA evidence
evidenceIndex.limitations: Registry is planning authority, not implementation evidence

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines required per-surface, control, API, data, test, and manual acceptance detail
evidenceIndex.result: Every journey must trace all surfaces and MAN-01 through MAN-14
evidenceIndex.limitations: Contract does not prove any journey is closed

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines target field capabilities and final closure counters
evidenceIndex.result: Requires assignment-scoped work, offline conflict handling, catalog, audit, COD, and cross-surface proof
evidenceIndex.limitations: Vision contains target state; live parity must be measured

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines final visions for all five surfaces
evidenceIndex.result: Field outcomes must be compared with client, partner, captain, and control-panel consumption
evidenceIndex.limitations: Vision documents may be ahead of implementation

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines eleven control-panel areas and their expected operational coverage
evidenceIndex.result: Dashboard, operations, analytics, partners, catalogs, marketing, finance, support, platform, administration, and HR are cross-surface readers or writers
evidenceIndex.limitations: Coverage registry does not prove live routes are complete

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows field runtime composition, identity/workforce/readiness gates, device fingerprint, push, and deep links
evidenceIndex.result: Runtime binds session and readiness before the DSH surface and parses multiple operational deep links
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static composition does not prove native configuration or device behavior

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows SDK and verification scripts
evidenceIndex.result: Expo 56, React Native 0.85, Sentry, notifications, SQLite, SecureStore, location, camera, and build checks are present
evidenceIndex.limitations: Installed dependency does not prove correct configuration or use

evidenceIndex.claim: Enumerates current field navigation states
evidenceIndex.result: Routes include stores, onboarding, visits, checklist, verification, finance, escalation, queue, profile, and product operations
evidenceIndex.limitations: Route presence does not prove reachable complete behavior

evidenceIndex.claim: Maps route states to field screens
evidenceIndex.result: Current UI composition links onboarding, stores, readiness, finance, profile, escalation, queue, and catalog screens
evidenceIndex.limitations: Screen import does not prove all controls are bound or accessible

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows offline mutation replay and field tab composition
evidenceIndex.result: Four mutation types replay with correlation and idempotency context; corrupt queue recovery is visible
evidenceIndex.limitations: Encryption, expiry, version migration, revocation, and unknown-result reconciliation need proof

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows field-readiness API paths and mutation identity
evidenceIndex.result: Stable keys are built for visit, check, and escalation operations; operator and partner read paths exist
evidenceIndex.limitations: Handwritten types/client authority relative to OpenAPI must be checked

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows visible controller state and error mapping
evidenceIndex.result: Loading, empty, success, and error states exist, but error mapping is coarse
evidenceIndex.limitations: Specific business codes and allowed recovery actions are not preserved

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows authorization gates and detailed backend errors
evidenceIndex.result: Backend distinguishes checklist, evidence, escalation, visit conflict, location, mocked GPS, and geofence failures
evidenceIndex.limitations: Registration, domain transactions, persistence, events, and all tests require further tracing

evidenceIndex.claim: Identify field OpenAPI path and schema sources
evidenceIndex.result: Field contracts exist in split OpenAPI sources
evidenceIndex.limitations: Generated consumer parity and completeness are not proven

evidenceIndex.claim: Live DSH control-panel route inventory
evidenceIndex.result: Eleven top-level DSH sections exist on the pinned branch
evidenceIndex.limitations: Top-level directories do not prove internal pages and controls are mapped

evidenceIndex.claim: Live WLT control-panel route inventory
evidenceIndex.result: Finance is the live WLT control-panel section
evidenceIndex.limitations: Its field/COD/settlement readback relationship requires tracing

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines SDK compatibility, deep links, notifications, background tasks, SecureStore, and SQLite behavior
evidenceIndex.result: Real push requires development/release builds; background work is OS-controlled; persistent and secure storage have platform constraints
evidenceIndex.limitations: External documentation is a test baseline, not repository evidence

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines platform accessibility APIs and Android/iOS differences
evidenceIndex.result: TalkBack, VoiceOver, focus, labels, roles, and touch controls need platform verification
evidenceIndex.limitations: Documentation does not prove app conformance

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust success criteria
evidenceIndex.result: Web/control-panel and applicable cross-platform UI checks should target Level AA criteria
evidenceIndex.limitations: WCAG techniques are informative and do not replace success-criteria testing

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines mobile storage, crypto, auth, network, platform, code, resilience, and privacy controls
evidenceIndex.result: Field session, device identity, offline data, deep links, media, network, and authorization require security verification
evidenceIndex.limitations: A checklist alone is not penetration-test evidence

evidenceIndex.claim: Repository-level binding test location discovered for operational capabilities
evidenceIndex.result: A dedicated binding test exists and should be extended to the field multi-surface matrix
evidenceIndex.limitations: Test result on the target implementation SHA is not yet available

entries.name: journey-and-surface-authority
entries.summary: The 107-journey registry, twenty-four-slice dossier contract, final surface visions, retirement rules, and section coverage govern the integrated plan.

entries.name: app-field-runtime-and-native-lifecycle
entries.summary: Runtime startup, secure session, fingerprint, readiness, deep links, push, background execution, EAS inputs, updates, and native lifecycle require cross-surface proof.

entries.name: field-shared-controllers-and-offline-policy
entries.summary: Shared DSH controllers, state models, API adapters, generated-client boundaries, offline queue, and read models must be the single reusable frontend brain.

entries.name: dsh-wlt-openapi-generated-client-and-errors
entries.summary: Operation IDs, schemas, security, idempotency, error codes, allowed actions, compatibility, and generated clients must cover every surface and transition.

entries.name: dsh-wlt-handlers-state-machines-and-orchestration
entries.summary: Transport, trusted context, authorization, orchestration, state transitions, concurrency, provider calls, and DSH-to-WLT facades must be traced end to end.

entries.name: migrations-persistence-projections-and-reconciliation
entries.summary: Field, partner, store, catalog, readiness, evidence, audit, COD references, projections, migrations, constraints, indexes, retention, replay, and reconciliation are in scope.

entries.name: mobile-api-data-privacy-and-abuse-controls
entries.summary: Secure storage, auth, network, deep-link input, media, location, privacy, scope abuse, device trust, offline records, and sensitive operations require MASVS-aligned verification.

entries.name: ui-ux-flow-accessibility-and-visible-state
entries.summary: Information architecture, controls, labels, RTL, large text, screen readers, focus, touch targets, loading, empty, blocked, conflict, offline, unknown result, and recovery are mandatory across surfaces.

entries.name: official-upstream-mobile-accessibility-security-standards
entries.summary: Official Expo, React Native, W3C WCAG 2.2, and OWASP MASVS/MASTG sources provide current platform and verification constraints.

entries.name: automated-and-manual-cross-surface-evidence
entries.summary: Static, unit, contract, backend integration, database, event, frontend, surface integration, runtime E2E, security, accessibility, performance, release, and manual evidence are required.
